description_en: Update the cloud connector instance information
description_zh: 更新云连接器实例信息
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc update-iot-cloud-connector-attribute --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateIoTCloudConnectorAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The name of the cloud connector instance.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, start with an uppercase or lowercase letter or a Chinese character, and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), or hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例的名称。

名称长度为2~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）或短划线（-）
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the cloud connector instance.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length, start with a letter or a Chinese character, and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例描述信息。

长度为2~256个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，但不能以`http://` 或`https://`开头
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_description

parameters.help_en:
Whether to enable the wildcard domain name feature. Valid values:
true (default): Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启泛域名功能。取值：
true（默认值）：开启。
false：关闭
parameters.name: wildcard_domain_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client to guarantee uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Whether to perform only a dry run of the request. Valid values:
true: Sends a dry run request without updating the instance information. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, whether the request format is valid, and whether business limits are met. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): Sends a normal request. After passing the checks, the instance information is updated directly
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会更新实例信息。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接更新实例信息
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cloud connector instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html API to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance mode. Valid values:

PassThrough: Pass-through mode.
VpcNat: Private network NAT mode
parameters.help_zh:
实例模式。取值：

PassThrough：直通模式。
VpcNat：私网NAT模式
parameters.name: mode
